author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Hello,

I have been temp-banned from Avicus for combat logging. I think that you should appeal my infraction because I received inadequate information on the rules of combat logging. A mod had previously told me that you were allowed to log out when you are in the void but not on land. And since that I have obeyed the rules that I thought were true, I believe that I should be unbanned. Please don't penalise me for a mistake of a mod.

With kind regards,

DaCrowMan

title: My temp-ban

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

This is the third time, I will not lift your punishment. If you decide to appeal again, I might extend your ban.

Regards,
Pelpelajax, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
